tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use a 1-hour Anthropic prompt-cache TTL, so effectively every allowed delay (the runtime clamps to [60, 3600]) wakes up with your conversation context still cached. There is no cache cliff inside that range to pace around, and scheduling extra wakeups just to keep the cache warm is pure waste — never do that. (If the session enters usage overage, later requests drop to the 5-minute TTL; don't try to track or preempt that — the guidance here stays the same.)

Match the delay to what you're actually waiting for:

- **Actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about** (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue): pick the delay from how fast that state actually changes. A CI run that takes ~8 minutes deserves one ~480s check, not eight 60s ones.
- **The long fallback heartbeat** (something else — a Monitor, a task notification — is the primary wake signal): 1200s+, so quiet wakeups stay rare.
- **Idle ticks with no specific signal to watch**: default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop still checks back regularly, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Don't think in cache windows — think about what you're actually waiting for.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""TK-433 шаг 2 (протокол P-TK433 v9b + уточнения Судьи): контроли и окна для tk422-features.py, свои v/m, слияние в таблицу признаков.
Подкоманды:
  windows <legs-th60.csv> <legs-th240.csv> <корень свечей> <aug-корень|-> <выход-каталог> [месяц ГГГГ-ММ]
      события = не исключённые ноги, представитель кластера (θ60: E60-n, θ240: E240-n); контроли: та же монета-рынок, та же длительность,
      тот же час UTC, ±30 суток, окно [старт−60, пик] не пересекает ни одну ногу ≥ 90 мин этого инструмента (любые θ, исключённые тоже),
      ≥ доли минут со свечой, как у события; до 5, детерминированно (md5 seed 433), без взаимных пересечений.
      Пишет windows.csv (для tk422-features), own.csv (v_in, v_pre, m_in, m_pre, hist_days), controls-diag.json.
  merge <windows.csv> <own.csv> <tk422-features.csv> <выход.csv>
      таблица признаков 12 (v_in, v_pre, m_in, m_pre, buy_in, buy_pre, sf_diff, sf_corr, oi_in, fund_in, liq_in, btc_in) по окну."""
import csv, gzip, hashlib, json, math, os, sys
from collections import defaultdict

MIN = 60000
SEED = 433
PRE = 60          # мин «до», протокол
NORM_D = 7        # суток нормы оборота
PER = 5
SPAN = 30         # суток ± для контроля (Судья 28.10: главный ±30, тот же час; ±7 — чувствительность)
MIN_HIST_D = 3


def month_bounds(ym):
    import datetime
    y, m = int(ym[:4]), int(ym[5:])
    a = datetime.datetime(y, m, 1, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    b = datetime.datetime(y + (m == 12), m % 12 + 1, 1, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    return int(a.timestamp() * 1000) // MIN, int(b.timestamp() * 1000) // MIN


def load(roots, sub, sym):
    d = {}
    for r in roots:
        fn = "%s/%s/%s.csv.gz" % (r, sub, sym) if r else None
        if fn and os.path.exists(fn):
            with gzip.open(fn, "rt") as f:
                f.readline()
                for line in f:
                    p = line.split(",", 7)
                    c = float(p[4])
                    if c > 0:
                        d[int(p[0]) // MIN] = (c, float(p[6] or 0))
    return d


def mad_demeaned(d, a, b):
    """MAD×1,4826 по 1 м логдоходностям закрытий в [a,b] за вычетом среднего (соседние минуты со свечой)."""
    r = []
    for m in range(a + 1, b + 1):
        if m in d and m - 1 in d:
            r.append(math.log(d[m][0] / d[m - 1][0]))
    if len(r) < 5:
        return None
    mu = sum(r) / len(r)
    x = sorted(v - mu for v in r)
    md = x[len(x) // 2]
    y = sorted(abs(v - md) for v in x)
    return y[len(y) // 2] * 1.4826


def med(x):
    y = sorted(x)
    return y[len(y) // 2] if y else None


def own_features(d, a, e, busy):
    """a..e — минуты окна ноги [старт, пик]; busy — [(i0,i1)] минуты всех ног ≥ 90 мин инструмента (исключаются из нормы)."""
    out = {"v_in": mad_demeaned(d, a, e), "v_pre": mad_demeaned(d, a - PRE, a - 1)}
    first = min(d) if d else a
    out["hist_days"] = round((a - first) / 1440, 2)
    norm = None
    if out["hist_days"] >= MIN_HIST_D:
        q = [d[m][1] for m in range(a - NORM_D * 1440, a) if m in d and not any(i0 <= m <= i1 for i0, i1 in busy)]
        norm = med(q)
    for nm, (x, y) in (("m_in", (a, e)), ("m_pre", (a - PRE, a - 1))):
        s = sum(d[m][1] for m in range(x, y + 1) if m in d)
        out[nm] = s / (norm * (y - x + 1)) if norm else None
    return out


PAIR = {"linear": "spot", "futures_usdt": "spot"}


def sf_features(df, ds, a, e, sg):
    """Спот↔фьючерс (Судья 28.10): basis_pre/in/chg (bps), lead_in (лаг 1 м), fsr_in. df/ds — свечи фьючерса/спота; нет спота — пусто."""
    out = dict(basis_pre=None, basis_in=None, basis_chg=None, lead_in=None, fsr_in=None)
    if not ds:
        return out
    bas = lambda m: (df[m][0] / ds[m][0] - 1) * 1e4 if m in df and m in ds else None
    pre = [x for x in (bas(m) for m in range(a - PRE, a)) if x is not None]
    inn = [(m, bas(m)) for m in range(a, e + 1)]
    inn = [(m, x) for m, x in inn if x is not None]
    out["basis_pre"] = med(pre)
    if inn:
        out["basis_in"] = med([x for _, x in inn])
        out["basis_chg"] = (inn[-1][1] - inn[0][1]) * sg
    rf, rs = {}, {}
    for m in range(a + 1, e + 1):
        if m in df and m - 1 in df and m in ds and m - 1 in ds:
            rf[m] = math.log(df[m][0] / df[m - 1][0])
            rs[m] = math.log(ds[m][0] / ds[m - 1][0])

    def corr(x, y):
        n = len(x)
        if n < 10:
            return None
        mx, my = sum(x) / n, sum(y) / n
        sxx = sum((v - mx) ** 2 for v in x)
        syy = sum((v - my) ** 2 for v in y)
        return sum((u - mx) * (v - my) for u, v in zip(x, y)) / math.sqrt(sxx * syy) if sxx > 0 and syy > 0 else None
    ks = [m for m in rf if m + 1 in rf]
    c1 = corr([rf[m] for m in ks], [rs[m + 1] for m in ks])
    c2 = corr([rs[m] for m in ks], [rf[m + 1] for m in ks])
    out["lead_in"] = None if c1 is None or c2 is None else c1 - c2
    qf = sum(df[m][1] for m in range(a, e + 1) if m in df)
    qs = sum(ds[m][1] for m in range(a, e + 1) if m in ds)
    out["fsr_in"] = math.log(qf / qs) if qf > 0 and qs > 0 else None
    return out


def cmd_windows(av):
    l60, l240, root, aug, outd = av[:5]
    ym = av[5] if len(av) > 5 else "2026-09"
    lo, hi = month_bounds(ym)
    roots = (aug if aug != "-" else None, root)
    os.makedirs(outd, exist_ok=True)
    legs = {}
    for tag, fn in (("60", l60), ("240", l240)):
        legs[tag] = list(csv.DictReader(open(fn, encoding="utf-8")))
    busy = defaultdict(set)
    for rs in legs.values():
        for r in rs:
            busy[(r["биржа"], r["рынок"], r["инструмент"])].add((int(r["t_start_ms"]) // MIN, int(r["t_peak_ms"]) // MIN))
    ev = []
    for tag, rs in legs.items():
        n = 0
        for r in rs:
            if r["исключено"] == "" and r.get("представитель") == "1":
                n += 1
                ev.append((tag, "E%s-%d" % (tag, n), r))
    byins = defaultdict(list)
    for e in ev:
        byins[(e[2]["биржа"], e[2]["рынок"], e[2]["инструмент"])].append(e)
    wins, own, diag = [], [], {"событий": defaultdict(int), "контролей": defaultdict(int), "без_контролей": [], "короткая_история": []}
    for (ex, mk, sym), L in sorted(byins.items()):
        sub = "%s-%s" % (ex, mk)
        d = load(roots, sub, sym)
        dsp = load(roots, "%s-%s" % (ex, PAIR[mk]), sym) if mk in PAIR else {}
        bz = sorted(busy[(ex, mk, sym)])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""TK-436 (G-017): куб признаков «инструмент × минута» на месяц — один раз, дальше детекторы читают memmap.
  tk436-cube.py candles <месяц ГГГГ-ММ> <корень свечей> <корень куба> [<корень свечей августа|->]
      <куб>/<sub>.npy  float64 (S, 5, T): o,h,l,c,q (q = quote_v); NaN = нет свечи (как в load() tk433-features), <sub>.syms — список.
  tk436-cube.py trades <месяц> <корень /data/tk417> <корень куба> [<процессов>]
      <куб>/trades-<sub>.npy float64 (S, 4, T): buy_q, sell_q, buy_n, sell_n по минуте (только поминутно, В-172/запрет посекундных не затронуты);
      sub = bybit-linear (foreignNotional, сторона Buy/Sell тикета) и bybit-spot (price*volume, buy/sell); сумма в порядке файла.
  tk436-cube.py check <куб> <sub> <инструмент> <корень свечей>   — сверка ячеек куба с исходным csv.gz (точное равенство)."""
import datetime, gzip, os, subprocess, sys
from multiprocessing import Pool
import numpy as np

MIN = 60000
SUBS = ("bybit-linear", "bybit-spot", "gate-futures_usdt", "gate-spot")
F = ("o", "h", "l", "c", "q")


def month_bounds(ym):
    y, m = int(ym[:4]), int(ym[5:])
    a = datetime.datetime(y, m, 1, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    b = datetime.datetime(y + (m == 12), m % 12 + 1, 1, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    return int(a.timestamp() * 1000) // MIN, int(b.timestamp() * 1000) // MIN


def read_candles(fn, lo, T):
    """свечи csv.gz -> (5,T); как tk433-features.load: c>0, минута = t_open_ms//60000."""
    out = np.full((5, T), np.nan)
    with gzip.open(fn, "rt") as f:
        f.readline()
        for line in f:
            p = line.split(",", 7)
            c = float(p[4])
            if c > 0:
                i = int(p[0]) // MIN - lo
                if 0 <= i < T:
                    out[:, i] = (float(p[1]), float(p[2]), float(p[3]), c, float(p[6] or 0))
    return out


def _cand_task(a):
    fn, lo, T = a
    return read_candles(fn, lo, T)


def cmd_candles(av):
    ym, root, outd = av[:3]
    aug = av[3] if len(av) > 3 and av[3] != "-" else None
    lo, hi = month_bounds(ym)
    T = hi - lo
    os.makedirs(outd, exist_ok=True)
    pool = Pool(int(os.environ.get("NPROC", "15")))
    for sub in SUBS:
        # август лежит в отдельном корне (как у tk433: сначала aug, затем основной корень поверх)
        srcs = {}
        for r in ([aug] if aug else []) + [root]:
            d = "%s/%s" % (r, sub)
            if os.path.isdir(d):
                for fn in os.listdir(d):
                    if fn.endswith(".csv.gz"):
                        srcs[fn[:-7]] = d + "/" + fn
        syms = sorted(srcs)
        if not syms:
            continue
        mm = np.lib.format.open_memmap("%s/%s.npy" % (outd, sub), mode="w+", dtype=np.float64, shape=(len(syms), 5, T))
        for i, arr in enumerate(pool.imap(_cand_task, [(srcs[s], lo, T) for s in syms], chunksize=4)):
            mm[i] = arr
        mm.flush()
        open("%s/%s.syms" % (outd, sub), "w").write("\n".join(syms) + "\n")
        print(sub, len(syms), "инструментов", flush=True)


AWK_LIN = r"""NR>1{m=int($1/60); k=m" "($3=="Buy"); s[k]+=$10; n[k]++} END{for(k in s) print k, s[k], n[k]}"""
AWK_SPOT = r"""NR>1{m=int($2/60000); k=m" "($5=="buy"); s[k]+=$3*$4; n[k]++} END{for(k in s) print k, s[k], n[k]}"""


def _trade_task(a):
    sub, path, lo, T = a
    awk = AWK_LIN if sub == "bybit-linear" else AWK_SPOT
    r = subprocess.run("zcat %s | mawk -F, '%s'" % (path, awk), shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    out = np.zeros((4, T))
    for ln in r.stdout.splitlines():
        m, buy, s, n = ln.split()
        i = int(m) - lo
        if 0 <= i < T:
            j = 0 if buy == "1" else 1
            out[j, i] += float(s)
            out[2 + j, i] += int(n)
    return out


def cmd_trades(av):
    ym, root, outd = av[:3]
    nproc = int(av[3]) if len(av) > 3 else 15
    lo, hi = month_bounds(ym)
    T = hi - lo
    os.makedirs(outd, exist_ok=True)
    pool = Pool(nproc)
    for sub in ("bybit-linear", "bybit-spot"):
        d = "%s/%s" % (root, sub)
        syms = sorted(os.listdir(d)) if os.path.isdir(d) else []
        tasks, owner = [], []
        for si, s in enumerate(syms):
            for fn in sorted(os.listdir("%s/%s" % (d, s))):
                tasks.append((sub, "%s/%s/%s" % (d, s, fn), lo, T))
                owner.append(si)
        mm = np.lib.format.open_memmap("%s/trades-%s.npy" % (outd, sub), mode="w+", dtype=np.float64, shape=(len(syms), 4, T))
        mm[:] = 0
        for si, arr in zip(owner, pool.imap(_trade_task, tasks, chunksize=1)):
            mm[si] += arr          # суточные файлы не пересекаются по минутам
        mm.flush()
        open("%s/trades-%s.syms" % (outd, sub), "w").write("\n".join(syms) + "\n")
        print(sub, len(syms), "инструментов", len(tasks), "файлов", flush=True)


def cmd_check(av):
    cube, sub, sym, root = av[:4]
    syms = open("%s/%s.syms" % (cube, sub)).read().split()
    mm = np.load("%s/%s.npy" % (cube, sub), mmap_mode="r")
    lo = None
    ref = read_candles("%s/%s/%s.csv.gz" % (root, sub, sym), 0, 10**9 // 1) if False else None
    T = mm.shape[2]
    first = None
    with gzip.open("%s/%s/%s.csv.gz" % (root, sub, sym), "rt") as f:
        f.readline()
        first = int(f.readline().split(",", 1)[0]) // MIN
    lo = first - first % 1440
    ref = read_candles("%s/%s/%s.csv.gz" % (root, sub, sym), lo, T)
    got = np.array(mm[syms.index(sym)])
    ok = np.array_equal(ref, got, equal_nan=True)
    print("check", sub, sym, "OK" if ok else "РАСХОЖДЕНИЕ", "ячеек", int(np.isfinite(got).sum()))
    sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    {"candles": cmd_candles, "trades": cmd_trades, "check": cmd_check}[sys.argv[1]](sys.argv[2:])

def load_ohlcq(roots, sub, sym):
    import gzip
    d = {}
    for r in roots:
        fn = "%s/%s/%s.csv.gz" % (r, sub, sym) if r else None
        if fn and os.path.exists(fn):
            with gzip.open(fn, "rt") as f:
                f.readline()
                for line in f:
                    p = line.split(",", 7)
                    c = float(p[4])
                    if c > 0:
                        d[int(p[0]) // MIN] = (c, float(p[6] or 0), float(p[2]), float(p[3]))
    return d


def atr_pct(d, start, tf, n=14):
    """ATR(n)/close×100 по ТФ-свечам (из 1 м): n последних полных баров до start (SMA TR); бары выровнены по эпохе."""
    e = start - start % tf
    bars = []
    for k in range(n + 1):
        b0 = e - (k + 1) * tf
        ms = [d[m] for m in range(b0, b0 + tf) if m in d]
        if not ms:
            return None
        bars.append((ms[0][0], max(x[2] for x in ms), min(x[3] for x in ms), ms[-1][0]))
    bars.reverse()
    tr = [max(h - l, abs(h - bars[i][3]), abs(l - bars[i][3])) for i, (_, h, l, _) in enumerate(bars[1:], 0)]
    return sum(tr) / len(tr) / bars[-1][3] * 100


def window_row(d, dsp, a, e0, sg, norm, rid):
    """a — старт, e0 — пик события (контроль: экстремум окна своего знака)."""
    pts = [(m, d[m][0]) for m in range(a, e0 + 1) if m in d]
    r = dict(id=rid)
    e = max(pts, key=lambda p: p[1] * sg)[0] if rid.startswith("C-") and pts else e0
    r["peak_min"] = e
    r["dur_min"] = e - a
    pts = [(m, c) for m, c in pts if m <= e]
    res = None
    if len(pts) >= 6:
        step = max(1, math.ceil(len(pts) / NPTS))
        sub = pts[::step]
        if sub[-1][0] != pts[-1][0]:
            sub.append(pts[-1])
        t = np.array([p[0] - a for p in sub], float)
        y = np.log(np.array([p[1] for p in sub], float))
        res = k1(t, y)
    if res:
        bk, segs = res
        sl = [s[2] * sg for s in segs]
        r["k1_k"] = bk
        r["k1_mono"] = int(bk >= 2 and all(sl[i] < sl[i + 1] for i in range(bk - 1)))
        r["k1_last_steepest"] = int(bk >= 2 and sl[-1] == max(sl))
        r["k1_last_slope_bps_min"] = sl[-1] * 1e4
        aa, bb = segs[-1][2], segs[-1][3]
        above = below = tot = 0
        for m in range(e - 60, e + 61):
            if m in d:
                line = aa * (m - a) + bb
                v = math.log(d[m][0])
                tot += 1
                above += v > line
                below += v < line
        r["k3_saw"] = min(above, below) / tot if tot else None
        brk = None
        for m in range(e + 1, e + 1 + CAP):
            if m in d and (math.log(d[m][0]) - (aa * (m - a) + bb)) * sg < 0:
                brk = m - e
                break
        r["brk_min"] = brk
        r["brk_cens"] = int(brk is None)
    # З1–З3: до = [e−60, e], после = (e, e+60]
    for nm, (x, y) in (("bef", (e - WIN, e)), ("aft", (e + 1, e + WIN))):
        s = sum(d[m][1] for m in range(x, y + 1) if m in d)
        r["m_" + nm] = s / (norm * (y - x + 1)) if norm else None
        r["v_" + nm] = F.mad_demeaned(d, x, y)
        if dsp:
            bs = [abs(d[m][0] / dsp[m][0] - 1) for m in range(x, y + 1) if m in d and m in dsp]
            r["bas_" + nm] = F.med(bs) if bs else None
    # старт
    r["dv24"] = sum(d[m][1] for m in range(a - 1440, a) if m in d)
    for nm, tf in (("natr15", 15), ("natr30", 30), ("natr60", 60), ("natr1d", 1440)):
        r[nm] = atr_pct(d, a, tf)
    cl = [d[m][0] for m in range(a - 60, a) if m in d]
    v7 = F.mad_demeaned(d, a - 7 * 1440, a - 1)
    r["cons_range"] = (max(cl) - min(cl)) / cl[-1] if len(cl) > 5 else None
    r["cons_ratio"] = r["cons_range"] / v7 if r["cons_range"] is not None and v7 else None
    return r


def main():
    legs, T, root, aug, outd = sys.argv[1:6]
    ym = sys.argv[6] if len(sys.argv) > 6 else "2026-09"
    os.makedirs(outd, exist_ok=True)
    empty = os.path.join(outd, "empty-legs.csv")
    with open(legs, encoding="utf-8") as f, open(empty, "w", encoding="utf-8") as g:
        g.write(f.readline())
    F.cmd_windows([legs, empty, root, aug, outd, ym])    # ноги варианта T идут как «θ60» файла windows.csv
    W = list(csv.DictReader(open(os.path.join(outd, "windows.csv"), encoding="utf-8")))
    roots = (aug if aug != "-" else None, root)
    busy = {}
    for r in csv.DictReader(open(legs, encoding="utf-8")):
        busy.setdefault((r["биржа"], r["рынок"], r["инструмент"]), []).append((int(r["t_start_ms"]) // MIN, int(r["t_peak_ms"]) // MIN))
    by = {}
    for w in W:
        by.setdefault((w["биржа"], w["рынок"], w["инструмент"]), []).append(w)
    rows = []
    for (ex, mk, sym), L in sorted(by.items()):
        d = load_ohlcq(roots, "%s-%s" % (ex, mk), sym)
        dsp = load_ohlcq(roots, "%s-%s" % (ex, F.PAIR[mk]), sym) if mk in F.PAIR else {}
        bz = busy.get((ex, mk, sym), [])
        for w in L:
            a, e0 = int(w["t_start"]) // MIN, int(w["t_peak"]) // MIN
            q = [d[m][1] for m in range(a - 7 * 1440, a) if m in d and not any(i0 <= m <= i1 for i0, i1 in bz)]
            norm = F.med(q) if len(q) > 1440 else None
            r = window_row(d, dsp, a, e0, int(w["знак"]), norm, w["id"])
            r.update(event_id=w["event_id"], роль=w["роль"], T=T, биржа=ex, рынок=mk, инструмент=sym, знак=w["знак"], start_min=a)
            rows.append(r)
    head = ("id", "event_id", "роль", "T", "биржа", "рынок", "инструмент", "знак")
    cols = sorted({k for r in rows for k in r}, key=lambda k: (k not in head, head.index(k) if k in head else 0, k))
    with open(os.path.join(outd, "end-start-th%s.csv" % T), "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        w = csv.DictWriter(f, cols, lineterminator="\n")
        w.writeheader()
        for r in rows:

def load_ohlcq(roots, sub, sym):
    import gzip
    d = {}
    for r in roots:
        fn = "%s/%s/%s.csv.gz" % (r, sub, sym) if r else None
        if fn and os.path.exists(fn):
            with gzip.open(fn, "rt") as f:
                f.readline()
                for line in f:
                    p = line.split(",", 7)
                    c = float(p[4])
                    if c > 0:
                        d[int(p[0]) // MIN] = (c, float(p[6] or 0), float(p[2]), float(p[3]))
    return d


def atr_pct(d, start, tf, n=14):
    """ATR(n)/close×100 по ТФ-свечам (из 1 м): n последних полных баров до start (SMA TR); бары выровнены по эпохе."""
    e = start - start % tf
    bars = []
    for k in range(n + 1):
        b0 = e - (k + 1) * tf
        ms = [d[m] for m in range(b0, b0 + tf) if m in d]
        if not ms:
            return None
        bars.append((ms[0][0], max(x[2] for x in ms), min(x[3] for x in ms), ms[-1][0]))
    bars.reverse()
    tr = [max(h - l, abs(h - bars[i][3]), abs(l - bars[i][3])) for i, (_, h, l, _) in enumerate(bars[1:], 0)]
    return sum(tr) / len(tr) / bars[-1][3] * 100


def window_row(d, dsp, a, e0, sg, norm, rid):
    """a — старт, e0 — пик события (контроль: экстремум окна своего знака)."""
    pts = [(m, d[m][0]) for m in range(a, e0 + 1) if m in d]
    r = dict(id=rid)
    e = max(pts, key=lambda p: p[1] * sg)[0] if rid.startswith("C-") and pts else e0
    r["peak_min"] = e
    r["dur_min"] = e - a
    pts = [(m, c) for m, c in pts if m <= e]
    res = None
    if len(pts) >= 6:
        step = max(1, math.ceil(len(pts) / NPTS))
        sub = pts[::step]
        if sub[-1][0] != pts[-1][0]:
            sub.append(pts[-1])
        t = np.array([p[0] - a for p in sub], float)
        y = np.log(np.array([p[1] for p in sub], float))
        res = k1(t, y)
    if res:
        bk, segs = res
        sl = [s[2] * sg for s in segs]
        r["k1_k"] = bk
        r["k1_mono"] = int(bk >= 2 and all(sl[i] < sl[i + 1] for i in range(bk - 1)))
        r["k1_last_steepest"] = int(bk >= 2 and sl[-1] == max(sl))
        r["k1_last_slope_bps_min"] = sl[-1] * 1e4
        aa, bb = segs[-1][2], segs[-1][3]
        above = below = tot = 0
        for m in range(e - 60, e + 61):
            if m in d:
                line = aa * (m - a) + bb
                v = math.log(d[m][0])
                tot += 1
                above += v > line
                below += v < line
        r["k3_saw"] = min(above, below) / tot if tot else None
        brk = None
        for m in range(e + 1, e + 1 + CAP):
            if m in d and (math.log(d[m][0]) - (aa * (m - a) + bb)) * sg < 0:
                brk = m - e
                break
        r["brk_min"] = brk
        r["brk_cens"] = int(brk is None)
    # З1–З3: до = [e−60, e], после = (e, e+60]
    for nm, (x, y) in (("bef", (e - WIN, e)), ("aft", (e + 1, e + WIN))):
        s = sum(d[m][1] for m in range(x, y + 1) if m in d)
        r["m_" + nm] = s / (norm * (y - x + 1)) if norm else None
        r["v_" + nm] = F.mad_demeaned(d, x, y)
        if dsp:
            bs = [abs(d[m][0] / dsp[m][0] - 1) for m in range(x, y + 1) if m in d and m in dsp]
            r["bas_" + nm] = F.med(bs) if bs else None
    # старт
    r["dv24"] = sum(d[m][1] for m in range(a - 1440, a) if m in d)
    for nm, tf in (("natr15", 15), ("natr30", 30), ("natr60", 60), ("natr1d", 1440)):
        r[nm] = atr_pct(d, a, tf)
    cl = [d[m][0] for m in range(a - 60, a) if m in d]
    v7 = F.mad_demeaned(d, a - 7 * 1440, a - 1)
    r["cons_range"] = (max(cl) - min(cl)) / cl[-1] if len(cl) > 5 else None
    r["cons_ratio"] = r["cons_range"] / v7 if r["cons_range"] is not None and v7 else None
    return r


def main():
    legs, T, root, aug, outd = sys.argv[1:6]
    ym = sys.argv[6] if len(sys.argv) > 6 else "2026-09"
    os.makedirs(outd, exist_ok=True)
    empty = os.path.join(outd, "empty-legs.csv")
    with open(legs, encoding="utf-8") as f, open(empty, "w", encoding="utf-8") as g:
        g.write(f.readline())
    F.cmd_windows([legs, empty, root, aug, outd, ym])    # ноги варианта T идут как «θ60» файла windows.csv
    W = list(csv.DictReader(open(os.path.join(outd, "windows.csv"), encoding="utf-8")))
    roots = (aug if aug != "-" else None, root)
    busy = {}
    for r in csv.DictReader(open(legs, encoding="utf-8")):
        busy.setdefault((r["биржа"], r["рынок"], r["инструмент"]), []).append((int(r["t_start_ms"]) // MIN, int(r["t_peak_ms"]) // MIN))
    by = {}
    for w in W:
        by.setdefault((w["биржа"], w["рынок"], w["инструмент"]), []).append(w)
    rows = []
    for (ex, mk, sym), L in sorted(by.items()):
        d = load_ohlcq(roots, "%s-%s" % (ex, mk), sym)
        dsp = load_ohlcq(roots, "%s-%s" % (ex, F.PAIR[mk]), sym) if mk in F.PAIR else {}
        bz = busy.get((ex, mk, sym), [])
        for w in L:
            a, e0 = int(w["t_start"]) // MIN, int(w["t_peak"]) // MIN
            q = [d[m][1] for m in range(a - 7 * 1440, a) if m in d and not any(i0 <= m <= i1 for i0, i1 in bz)]
            norm = F.med(q) if len(q) > 1440 else None
            r = window_row(d, dsp, a, e0, int(w["знак"]), norm, w["id"])
            r.update(event_id=w["event_id"], роль=w["роль"], T=T, биржа=ex, рынок=mk, инструмент=sym, знак=w["знак"], start_min=a)
            rows.append(r)
    head = ("id", "event_id", "роль", "T", "биржа", "рынок", "инструмент", "знак")
    cols = sorted({k for r in rows for k in r}, key=lambda k: (k not in head, head.index(k) if k in head else 0, k))
    with open(os.path.join(outd, "end-start-th%s.csv" % T), "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        w = csv.DictWriter(f, cols, lineterminator="\n")
        w.writeheader()
        for r in rows:
            w.writerow({k: ("" if v is None else v) for k, v in r.items()})
    print("окон", len(rows), "событий", sum(r["роль"] == "event" for r in rows))

Считает по окнам файла end-start: dv24, natr15/30/60/1d, cons_range, cons_ratio, m_bef/m_aft, v_bef/v_aft
  «стало» = куб (memmap) + срезы numpy; «было» = load_ohlcq + atr_pct + F.mad_demeaned из tk433-end.py (те же функции, что в боевом прогоне);

        r = np.arange(n + 1)
        c0, c1 = cc[r, first], cc[r, last]
        hi = np.where(ok, hh, -np.inf).max(axis=1)
        lo_ = np.where(ok, ll, np.inf).min(axis=1)
        tr = [max(hi[i] - lo_[i], abs(hi[i] - c1[i - 1]), abs(lo_[i] - c1[i - 1])) for i in range(1, n + 1)]
        return sum(tr) / len(tr) / c1[-1] * 100

    def start(self, a):
        o = {"dv24": self.qsum(a - 1440, a - 1)}
        for nm, tf in (("natr15", 15), ("natr30", 30), ("natr60", 60), ("natr1d", 1440)):
            o[nm] = self.natr(a, tf)
        cl = self.c[a - 60 - self.lo:a - self.lo]
        cl = cl[np.isfinite(cl)]
        v7 = self.mad(a - 7 * 1440, a - 1)
        rng = (float(cl.max()) - float(cl.min())) / float(cl[-1]) if len(cl) > 5 else None
        o["cons_range"] = rng
        o["cons_ratio"] = rng / v7 if rng is not None and v7 else None
        return o

    def around(self, e, norm):
        o = {}
        for nm, (x, y) in (("bef", (e - 60, e)), ("aft", (e + 1, e + 60))):
            o["m_" + nm] = self.qsum(x, y) / (norm * (y - x + 1)) if norm else None
            o["v_" + nm] = self.mad(x, y)
        return o


def old_measures(d, a, e, norm):
    o = {"dv24": sum(d[m][1] for m in range(a - 1440, a) if m in d)}
    for nm, tf in (("natr15", 15), ("natr30", 30), ("natr60", 60), ("natr1d", 1440)):
        o[nm] = E.atr_pct(d, a, tf)
    cl = [d[m][0] for m in range(a - 60, a) if m in d]
    v7 = F.mad_demeaned(d, a - 7 * 1440, a - 1)
    rng = (max(cl) - min(cl)) / cl[-1] if len(cl) > 5 else None
    o["cons_range"] = rng
    o["cons_ratio"] = rng / v7 if rng is not None and v7 else None
    for nm, (x, y) in (("bef", (e - 60, e)), ("aft", (e + 1, e + 60))):
        s = sum(d[m][1] for m in range(x, y + 1) if m in d)
        o["m_" + nm] = s / (norm * (y - x + 1)) if norm else None
        o["v_" + nm] = F.mad_demeaned(d, x, y)
    return o


def cmd_gate(av):
    es, legs, cube, root, aug = av[:5]
    nmax = int(av[5]) if len(av) > 5 else 10 ** 9
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(es, encoding="utf-8")))[:nmax]
    busy = {}
    for r in csv.DictReader(open(legs, encoding="utf-8")):
        busy.setdefault((r["биржа"], r["рынок"], r["инструмент"]), []).append((int(r["t_start_ms"]) // MIN, int(r["t_peak_ms"]) // MIN))
    by = {}
    for r in rows:
        by.setdefault((r["биржа"], r["рынок"], r["инструмент"]), []).append(r)
    roots = (aug if aug != "-" else None, root)
    keys = ["dv24", "natr15", "natr30", "natr60", "natr1d", "cons_range", "cons_ratio", "m_bef", "m_aft", "v_bef", "v_aft"]
    t_old = t_new = t_load_new = 0.0
    n = ex_old = ex_new = diff_new = 0
    worst = 0.0
    cubes = {}
    for (ex, mk, sym), L in sorted(by.items()):
        sub = "%s-%s" % (ex, mk)
        if sub not in cubes:
            syms = open("%s/%s.syms" % (cube, sub)).read().split()
            t0 = time.time()
            cubes[sub] = (np.load("%s/%s.npy" % (cube, sub), mmap_mode="r"), {s: i for i, s in enumerate(syms)}, int(open("%s/%s.lo" % (cube, sub)).read()))
            t_load_new += time.time() - t0
        arr, ix, lo = cubes[sub]
        if sym not in ix:
            continue
        bz = busy.get((ex, mk, sym), [])
        t0 = time.time()
        d = E.load_ohlcq(roots, sub, sym)
        old = []
        for r in L:
            a, e = int(r["start_min"]), int(r["peak_min"])
            q = [d[m][1] for m in range(a - 7 * 1440, a) if m in d and not any(i0 <= m <= i1 for i0, i1 in bz)]
            norm = F.med(q) if len(q) > 1440 else None
            old.append(old_measures(d, a, e, norm))
        t_old += time.time() - t0
        t0 = time.time()
        s = Sym(np.asarray(arr[ix[sym]]), lo, bz)
        new = []
        for r in L:
            a, e = int(r["start_min"]), int(r["peak_min"])
            o = s.start(a)
            o.update(s.around(e, s.norm(a)))
            new.append(o)
        t_new += time.time() - t0
        for r, o, w in zip(L, old, new):
            n += 1
            for k in keys:
                f = r.get(k, "")
                f = float(f) if f != "" else None
                for src, nm in ((o, "old"), (w, "new")):
                    v = src[k]
                    if (v is None) != (f is None) or (v is not None and v != f):
                        if v is not None and f is not None:
                            worst = max(worst, abs(v - f) / max(abs(f), 1e-300))
                        if nm == "old":
                            ex_old += 1
                        else:
                            ex_new += 1
    print("окон %d инструментов %d мер %d" % (n, len(by), len(keys)))
    print("было (разбор csv.gz + циклы): %.2f с; стало (куб, срезы): %.2f с + открытие куба %.2f с; ускорение ×%.1f" % (t_old, t_new, t_load_new, t_old / max(t_new, 1e-9)))
    print("расхождений с файлом end-start: было %d, стало %d из %d; макс. относит. %.2e" % (ex_old, ex_new, n * len(keys), worst))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    {"gate": cmd_gate}[sys.argv[1]](sys.argv[2:])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""TK-436 (G-017): куб признаков «инструмент × минута» на месяц — один раз, дальше детекторы читают memmap.
  tk436-cube.py candles <месяц ГГГГ-ММ> <корень свечей> <корень куба> [<корень свечей августа|->]
      <куб>/<sub>.npy  float64 (S, 5, T): o,h,l,c,q (q = quote_v); NaN = нет свечи (как в load() tk433-features), <sub>.syms — список.
  tk436-cube.py trades <месяц> <корень /data/tk417> <корень куба> [<процессов>]
      <куб>/trades-<sub>.npy float64 (S, 4, T): buy_q, sell_q, buy_n, sell_n по минуте (только поминутно, В-172/запрет посекундных не затронуты);
      sub = bybit-linear (foreignNotional, сторона Buy/Sell тикета) и bybit-spot (price*volume, buy/sell); сумма в порядке файла.
  tk436-cube.py check <куб> <sub> <инструмент> <корень свечей> — c и q куба == независимый разбор csv.gz (точное равенство)."""
import datetime, gzip, os, subprocess, sys
from multiprocessing import Pool
import numpy as np

MIN = 60000
SUBS = ("bybit-linear", "bybit-spot", "gate-futures_usdt", "gate-spot")
F = ("o", "h", "l", "c", "q")
PAD = 15                  # суток запаса назад в кубе свечей


def month_bounds(ym):
    y, m = int(ym[:4]), int(ym[5:])
    a = datetime.datetime(y, m, 1, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    b = datetime.datetime(y + (m == 12), m % 12 + 1, 1, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    return int(a.timestamp() * 1000) // MIN, int(b.timestamp() * 1000) // MIN


def read_candles(fn, lo, T):
    """свечи csv.gz -> (5,T); как tk433-features.load: c>0, минута = t_open_ms//60000."""
    out = np.full((5, T), np.nan)
    with gzip.open(fn, "rt") as f:
        f.readline()
        for line in f:
            p = line.split(",", 7)
            c = float(p[4])
            if c > 0:
                i = int(p[0]) // MIN - lo
                if 0 <= i < T:
                    out[:, i] = (float(p[1]), float(p[2]), float(p[3]), c, float(p[6] or 0))
    return out


def _cand_task(a):
    """несколько корней: читаются по порядку, поздний перекрывает ранний по минуте (как load() tk433 с roots=(aug, root))."""
    fns, lo, T = a
    out = read_candles(fns[0], lo, T)
    for fn in fns[1:]:
        x = read_candles(fn, lo, T)
        ok = np.isfinite(x[3])
        out[:, ok] = x[:, ok]
    return out


def cmd_candles(av):
    ym, root, outd = av[:3]
    aug = av[3] if len(av) > 3 and av[3] != "-" else None
    lo, hi = month_bounds(ym)
    lo -= PAD * 1440          # запас назад: норма 7 сут, natr суточный (15 суток) у первых окон месяца берут историю прошлого месяца
    T = hi - lo
    os.makedirs(outd, exist_ok=True)
    pool = Pool(int(os.environ.get("NPROC", "15")))
    for sub in SUBS:
        # август лежит в отдельном корне (как у tk433: сначала aug, затем основной корень поверх)
        srcs = {}
        for r in ([aug] if aug else []) + [root]:
            d = "%s/%s" % (r, sub)
            if os.path.isdir(d):
                for fn in os.listdir(d):
                    if fn.endswith(".csv.gz"):
                        srcs.setdefault(fn[:-7], []).append(d + "/" + fn)
        syms = sorted(srcs)
        if not syms:
            continue
        mm = np.lib.format.open_memmap("%s/%s.npy" % (outd, sub), mode="w+", dtype=np.float64, shape=(len(syms), 5, T))
        for i, arr in enumerate(pool.imap(_cand_task, [(srcs[s], lo, T) for s in syms], chunksize=4)):
            mm[i] = arr
        mm.flush()
        open("%s/%s.syms" % (outd, sub), "w").write("\n".join(syms) + "\n")
        print(sub, len(syms), "инструментов", flush=True)


AWK_LIN = r"""NR>1{m=int($1/60); k=m" "($3=="Buy"); s[k]+=$10; n[k]++} END{for(k in s) print k, s[k], n[k]}"""
AWK_SPOT = r"""NR>1{m=int($2/60000); k=m" "($5=="buy"); s[k]+=$3*$4; n[k]++} END{for(k in s) print k, s[k], n[k]}"""


def _trade_task(a):
    sub, path, lo, T = a
    awk = AWK_LIN if sub == "bybit-linear" else AWK_SPOT
    r = subprocess.run("zcat %s | mawk -F, '%s'" % (path, awk), shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    out = np.zeros((4, T))
    for ln in r.stdout.splitlines():
        m, buy, s, n = ln.split()
        i = int(m) - lo
        if 0 <= i < T:
            j = 0 if buy == "1" else 1
            out[j, i] += float(s)
            out[2 + j, i] += int(n)
    return out


def cmd_trades(av):
    ym, root, outd = av[:3]
    nproc = int(av[3]) if len(av) > 3 else 15
    lo, hi = month_bounds(ym)
    T = hi - lo
    os.makedirs(outd, exist_ok=True)
    pool = Pool(nproc)
    for sub in ("bybit-linear", "bybit-spot"):
        d = "%s/%s" % (root, sub)
        syms = sorted(os.listdir(d)) if os.path.isdir(d) else []
        tasks, owner = [], []
        for si, s in enumerate(syms):
            for fn in sorted(os.listdir("%s/%s" % (d, s))):
                tasks.append((sub, "%s/%s/%s" % (d, s, fn), lo, T))
                owner.append(si)
        mm = np.lib.format.open_memmap("%s/trades-%s.npy" % (outd, sub), mode="w+", dtype=np.float64, shape=(len(syms), 4, T))
        mm[:] = 0
        for si, arr in zip(owner, pool.imap(_trade_task, tasks, chunksize=1)):
            mm[si] += arr          # суточные файлы не пересекаются по минутам
        mm.flush()
        open("%s/trades-%s.syms" % (outd, sub), "w").write("\n".join(syms) + "\n")
        print(sub, len(syms), "инструментов", len(tasks), "файлов", flush=True)


def cmd_check(av):
    cube, sub, sym, root = av[:4]
    syms = open("%s/%s.syms" % (cube, sub)).read().split()
    mm = np.load("%s/%s.npy" % (cube, sub), mmap_mode="r")
    T = mm.shape[2]
    lo = int(open("%s/%s.lo" % (cube, sub)).read())
    got = np.array(mm[syms.index(sym)])
    d = {}                   # независимый разбор — копия load() из tk433-features.py: {минута: (close, quote_v)}
    with gzip.open("%s/%s/%s.csv.gz" % (root, sub, sym), "rt") as f:
        f.readline()
        for line in f:
            p = line.split(",", 7)
            c = float(p[4])
            if c > 0:
                d[int(p[0]) // MIN] = (c, float(p[6] or 0))
    bad = 0
    for i in range(T):
        e = d.get(lo + i)
        if e is None:
            bad += not np.isnan(got[3, i])
        else:
            bad += not (got[3, i] == e[0] and got[4, i] == e[1])
    print("check", sub, sym, "OK" if bad == 0 else "РАСХОЖДЕНИЙ %d" % bad, "ячеек", int(np.isfinite(got[3]).sum()))
    sys.exit(0 if bad == 0 else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    {"candles": cmd_candles, "trades": cmd_trades, "check": cmd_check}[sys.argv[1]](sys.argv[2:])

lines: +        open("%s/%s.lo" % (outd, sub), "w").write("%d\n" % lo)     # первая минута эпохи (колонка 0 оси T)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""TK-436 (G-017): куб признаков «инструмент × минута» на месяц — один раз, дальше детекторы читают memmap.
  tk436-cube.py candles <месяц ГГГГ-ММ> <корень свечей> <корень куба> [<корень свечей августа|->]
      <куб>/<sub>.npy  float64 (S, 5, T): o,h,l,c,q (q = quote_v); NaN = нет свечи (как в load() tk433-features), <sub>.syms — список.
  tk436-cube.py trades <месяц> <корень /data/tk417> <корень куба> [<процессов>]
      <куб>/trades-<sub>.npy float64 (S, 4, T): buy_q, sell_q, buy_n, sell_n по минуте (только поминутно, В-172/запрет посекундных не затронуты);
      sub = bybit-linear (foreignNotional, сторона Buy/Sell тикета) и bybit-spot (price*volume, buy/sell); сумма в порядке файла.
  tk436-cube.py check <куб> <sub> <инструмент> <корень свечей> — c и q куба == независимый разбор csv.gz (точное равенство)."""
import datetime, gzip, os, subprocess, sys
from multiprocessing import Pool
import numpy as np

MIN = 60000
SUBS = ("bybit-linear", "bybit-spot", "gate-futures_usdt", "gate-spot")
F = ("o", "h", "l", "c", "q")
PAD = 15                  # суток запаса назад в кубе свечей


def month_bounds(ym):
    y, m = int(ym[:4]), int(ym[5:])
    a = datetime.datetime(y, m, 1, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    b = datetime.datetime(y + (m == 12), m % 12 + 1, 1, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    return int(a.timestamp() * 1000) // MIN, int(b.timestamp() * 1000) // MIN


def read_candles(fn, lo, T):
    """свечи csv.gz -> (5,T); как tk433-features.load: c>0, минута = t_open_ms//60000."""
    out = np.full((5, T), np.nan)
    with gzip.open(fn, "rt") as f:
        f.readline()
        for line in f:
            p = line.split(",", 7)
            c = float(p[4])
            if c > 0:
                i = int(p[0]) // MIN - lo
                if 0 <= i < T:
                    out[:, i] = (float(p[1]), float(p[2]), float(p[3]), c, float(p[6] or 0))
    return out


def _cand_task(a):
    """несколько корней: читаются по порядку, поздний перекрывает ранний по минуте (как load() tk433 с roots=(aug, root))."""
    fns, lo, T = a
    out = read_candles(fns[0], lo, T)
    for fn in fns[1:]:
        x = read_candles(fn, lo, T)
        ok = np.isfinite(x[3])
        out[:, ok] = x[:, ok]
    return out


def cmd_candles(av):
    ym, root, outd = av[:3]
    aug = av[3] if len(av) > 3 and av[3] != "-" else None
    lo, hi = month_bounds(ym)
    lo -= PAD * 1440          # запас назад: норма 7 сут, natr суточный (15 суток) у первых окон месяца берут историю прошлого месяца
    T = hi - lo
    os.makedirs(outd, exist_ok=True)
    pool = Pool(int(os.environ.get("NPROC", "15")))
    for sub in SUBS:
        # август лежит в отдельном корне (как у tk433: сначала aug, затем основной корень поверх)
        srcs = {}
        for r in ([aug] if aug else []) + [root]:
            d = "%s/%s" % (r, sub)
            if os.path.isdir(d):
                for fn in os.listdir(d):
                    if fn.endswith(".csv.gz"):
                        srcs.setdefault(fn[:-7], []).append(d + "/" + fn)
        syms = sorted(srcs)
        if not syms:
            continue
        mm = np.lib.format.open_memmap("%s/%s.npy" % (outd, sub), mode="w+", dtype=np.float64, shape=(len(syms), 5, T))
        for i, arr in enumerate(pool.imap(_cand_task, [(srcs[s], lo, T) for s in syms], chunksize=4)):
            mm[i] = arr
        mm.flush()
        open("%s/%s.syms" % (outd, sub), "w").write("\n".join(syms) + "\n")
        open("%s/%s.lo" % (outd, sub), "w").write("%d\n" % lo)     # первая минута эпохи (колонка 0 оси T)
        print(sub, len(syms), "инструментов", flush=True)


AWK_LIN = r"""NR>1{m=int($1/60); k=m" "($3=="Buy"); s[k]+=$10; n[k]++} END{for(k in s) print k, s[k], n[k]}"""
AWK_SPOT = r"""NR>1{m=int($2/60000); k=m" "($5=="buy"); s[k]+=$3*$4; n[k]++} END{for(k in s) print k, s[k], n[k]}"""


def _trade_task(a):
    sub, path, lo, T = a
    awk = AWK_LIN if sub == "bybit-linear" else AWK_SPOT
    r = subprocess.run("zcat %s | mawk -F, '%s'" % (path, awk), shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    out = np.zeros((4, T))
    for ln in r.stdout.splitlines():
        m, buy, s, n = ln.split()
        i = int(m) - lo
        if 0 <= i < T:
            j = 0 if buy == "1" else 1
            out[j, i] += float(s)
            out[2 + j, i] += int(n)
    return out


def cmd_trades(av):
    ym, root, outd = av[:3]
    nproc = int(av[3]) if len(av) > 3 else 15
    lo, hi = month_bounds(ym)
    T = hi - lo
    os.makedirs(outd, exist_ok=True)
    pool = Pool(nproc)
    for sub in ("bybit-linear", "bybit-spot"):
        d = "%s/%s" % (root, sub)
        syms = sorted(os.listdir(d)) if os.path.isdir(d) else []
        tasks, owner = [], []
        for si, s in enumerate(syms):
            for fn in sorted(os.listdir("%s/%s" % (d, s))):
                tasks.append((sub, "%s/%s/%s" % (d, s, fn), lo, T))
                owner.append(si)
        mm = np.lib.format.open_memmap("%s/trades-%s.npy" % (outd, sub), mode="w+", dtype=np.float64, shape=(len(syms), 4, T))
        mm[:] = 0
        for si, arr in zip(owner, pool.imap(_trade_task, tasks, chunksize=1)):
            mm[si] += arr          # суточные файлы не пересекаются по минутам
        mm.flush()
        open("%s/trades-%s.syms" % (outd, sub), "w").write("\n".join(syms) + "\n")
        print(sub, len(syms), "инструментов", len(tasks), "файлов", flush=True)


def cmd_check(av):
    cube, sub, sym, root = av[:4]
    syms = open("%s/%s.syms" % (cube, sub)).read().split()
    mm = np.load("%s/%s.npy" % (cube, sub), mmap_mode="r")
    T = mm.shape[2]
    lo = int(open("%s/%s.lo" % (cube, sub)).read())
    got = np.array(mm[syms.index(sym)])
    d = {}                   # независимый разбор — копия load() из tk433-features.py: {минута: (close, quote_v)}
    with gzip.open("%s/%s/%s.csv.gz" % (root, sub, sym), "rt") as f:
        f.readline()
        for line in f:
            p = line.split(",", 7)
            c = float(p[4])
            if c > 0:
                d[int(p[0]) // MIN] = (c, float(p[6] or 0))
    bad = 0
    for i in range(T):
        e = d.get(lo + i)
        if e is None:
            bad += not np.isnan(got[3, i])
        else:
            bad += not (got[3, i] == e[0] and got[4, i] == e[1])
    print("check", sub, sym, "OK" if bad == 0 else "РАСХОЖДЕНИЙ %d" % bad, "ячеек", int(np.isfinite(got[3]).sum()))
    sys.exit(0 if bad == 0 else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    {"candles": cmd_candles, "trades": cmd_trades, "check": cmd_check}[sys.argv[1]](sys.argv[2:])

# TK-436 — куб признаков «инструмент × минута» и гейт «было/стало» (28.10)

**Результат:** куб сентября (с запасом 15 суток августа) построен на calc один раз за 4 мин; меры окна поверх куба дают те же числа, что боевой код TK-433, и считаются в **×14,7** быстрее (одним процессом).

## Куб (calc `/data/tk0436/cube2/`, скрипт `tools/compute/tk436-cube.py`)

| файл | форма | содержимое | сборка |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<sub>.npy` + `.syms` + `.lo` | (инструменты, 5, T=64 800) float64 | o,h,l,c,q по минуте; NaN = нет свечи; август+сентябрь слиты как `load()` в tk433 | 4 суб-рынка (bybit-linear 967, bybit-spot 527, gate-futures_usdt 1018, gate-spot 2169), job 1028015154239, ~2,5 мин на 15 ядрах |
| `trades-bybit-{linear,spot}.npy` | (50 / 17, 4, 43 200) | buy_q, sell_q, buy_n, sell_n по минуте (только поминутно) | job 1028015026818, ~3 мин: 1404 + 17 файлов сделок, `zcat \| mawk` по файлу |

Занимает 11,8 ГБ (candles) + 1,5 ГБ (trades). Читается memmap'ом: открытие куба ≈ 0 с.
Было: каждый прогон TK-421/433 разбирал `csv.gz` инструментов заново (+ окно сделок 15 ГБ → oom).

## Гейт (`tk436-vec.py gate`, вход — `/data/tk433/e5/end-start-th5.csv`, ноги θ5 сентября)

1821 окно (события + контроли), 538 инструментов, 11 мер: `dv24, natr15/30/60/1d, cons_range, cons_ratio, m_bef, m_aft, v_bef, v_aft`.

| | стена | расхождений с `end-start-th5.csv` |
|---|---|---|
| было (`load_ohlcq` + циклы, функции tk433-end.py) | 95,8 с | 0 из 20 031 |
| стало (куб + срезы numpy) | 6,5 с | **0 из 20 031**, макс. отн. 0 |

Точное равенство потребовало двух деталей: `math.log` вместо `np.log` (SIMD-лог отличается на 1 ulp) и питоновские `float` в `sum()` (py3.12+ суммирует их с компенсацией; `np.float64` — нет). Без них 61 из 2 684 значений расходилось на 4e-16.

## Что осталось (TK-436)

- OI / фандинг / ликвидации Gate в куб; сверка сделочных признаков К4–К8 (`tk433-trades.py`) с кубом сделок.
- Детектор окна TK-435 и меры волатильности v11 (RV, Parkinson, MAD, natr 1 м/5 м с периодом N) — векторно поверх куба; контроли — запросом к кубу.
- `k1` (DP кусочной линейной) — самый тяжёлый цикл `tk433-end.py` (O(k·n²)); в гейт не входит.
- `check` в `tk436-cube.py` сверяет куб с одним корнем свечей: у куба запас = август, поэтому первые 21 600 минут в сверке «расходятся» (в корне сентября их нет) — сентябрьские 43 200 равны.
